verdict_note: No blockers. Three major findings (F1 link contrast, F2 focus lost to body after Reload, F3 nameless modal dialog now exposed to AT). Each is a small, local fix; with F1-F3 fixed the verdict becomes PASS WITH MINOR.

checks.evidence: One h1 from PageHeader (page-header.tsx:~196, AvailabilityContent.tsx:220-242). Each card is <section aria-labelledby> with an h2 via SectionHeader headingLevel=2 (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:92-100, TimezoneCard.tsx:36-44, AvailabilityContent.tsx:270-277, BuffersCapCard.tsx:48-56; section-header.tsx:38,47-53). EmptyState title is an h3 (empty-state.tsx:425), correctly under the Closures h2. Minor: EmptyState also renders role=region tabIndex=0 (empty-state.tsx:400-403), see F10.

Switches: aria-label '<Day> open' (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:134), cap switch has <Label htmlFor='cap-enabled'> (BuffersCapCard.tsx:108-114). Time inputs 'Monday range N start/end' (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:160,175), closure inputs 'Closure N start date / end date / reason (optional)' (ClosuresList.tsx:140,155,166), each unique by day/index. Remove buttons named per row (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:186, ClosuresList.tsx:28-32,175). Timezone trigger named by Label htmlFor (TimezoneCard.tsx:52-55, TimezoneSelector.tsx:159-162). Number inputs have Labels (BuffersCapCard.tsx:89,118). aria-invalid + aria-describedby to error id on every field (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:161-162,176-177; ClosuresList.tsx:123-127; BuffersCapCard.tsx:100-101,129-130; TimezoneCard.tsx:31-33,60-61). Label-in-name (2.5.3) holds: visible 'Monday' is inside 'Monday open'; 'Reason (optional)' is inside the aria-label. Advisory: time/date inputs have no visible label (F9).

ErrorSummary is role=alert with in-page links that preventDefault and focus the field (AvailabilityBanners.tsx:41-65). handleSave focuses the first invalid field via focusTarget effect (AvailabilityContent.tsx:128-132,178-185). ServerErrorBanner is role=alert tabIndex=-1 and focused on mount (AvailabilityBanners.tsx:74-97). CONFLICT shows a Reload button (AvailabilityBanners.tsx:92-96) and disables Save (AvailabilityContent.tsx:163-165). Errors are recomputed from the draft on every change (AvailabilityContent.tsx:135-138) so field errors clear when fixed. Caveats: F2 (Reload focus) and F7 (summary re-announces while typing).

Single always-mounted <output aria-live=polite> (AvailabilityContent.tsx:244-246; output already has implicit role=status). Messages are unique per action: add/remove range (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:62,68,76-78), add/remove closure (ClosuresList.tsx:62,67,81-83), timezone (TimezoneCard.tsx:58), reset (AvailabilityContent.tsx:43-44,208). Save success is toast only (AvailabilityContent.tsx:189), not also announced via <output>. Reset: announcement plus focus move to the heading are different content, not a duplicate. Info: identical consecutive strings (e.g. a second Reset) set the same state and are not re-announced (F11).

OK: add range -> new start input (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:69), remove range -> same index start, else previous, else Add range (79-82), add closure -> new start date (ClosuresList.tsx:68), remove closure -> same index/previous/Add Closure button (84-85), Save success -> Weekly hours title (AvailabilityContent.tsx:191; title has tabIndex=-1 via focusableTitle, WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:101, section-header.tsx:49), Reset -> title via onCloseAutoFocus (AvailabilityContent.tsx:320-325; flag is set before onOpenChange(false) in confirmation-dialog.tsx:79-81, so it is set in time). FAIL: handleReload (AvailabilityContent.tsx:197-201) never sets a focus target, so when the focused ServerErrorBanner unmounts focus falls to body; the spec requires Weekly hours title after Reload (PG-202-spec.md:370) and no test asserts it (AvailabilityContent.actions.test.tsx:178-193). See F2. Also F4.

Removing aria-hidden from the backdrop is correct: aria-hidden=true on an ancestor of the open <dialog> hid the dialog and its focusable children from AT (4.1.2). The Escape handler is now a document keydown listener registered only while a dialog is active, cleaned up on change (AppointmentDetail.tsx:93-101); it works wherever focus is, and Tab is wrapped by useFocusTrap (useFocusTrap.ts:30-47) which also restores focus on close (49-52). No trap. Nothing else aria-hides content: the page behind is neither aria-hidden nor inert, relying on aria-modal=true (AppointmentDetail.tsx:582, element is a non-modal <dialog open>), which current AT honour. Open items: dialog has no accessible name (F3); Escape also closes while an action is in flight (F8).

Computed from globals.css:152-199 tokens and Tailwind default palette (see contrast[]). Error text, muted text, 'Unsaved changes' and slate-700 note text pass. AvailabilityPointer link text-primary on slate-50 is 3.97:1 (light) and 3.52:1 (dark): FAIL 1.4.3 (AvailabilityPointer.tsx:9, F1). Non-text contrast of input borders and the unchecked switch track is about 1.2:1 (F5, pre-existing shared tokens). White on primary (Save Changes, default Button) is 4.15:1 (F6, pre-existing shared token). jsdom axe had color-contrast disabled (AvailabilityContent.test.tsx:69), so none of this was machine-checked.

Remove buttons h-11 w-11 (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:185, ClosuresList.tsx:174), Add range min-h-11 (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:223), inputs h-10 (input.tsx:11), Switch h-6 w-11 = 24px, meets the 24px minimum exactly (switch.tsx:8), Button sm h-9 (button.tsx:20). Reflow at 320px: rows use flex-wrap with flex-1 and min-w 7.5rem (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:152,163,178) and 9rem/12rem (ClosuresList.tsx:130,141,156,168), grid is grid-cols-1 below lg (AvailabilityContent.tsx:252), PageHeader actions wrap (page-header.tsx:~203), fieldset has min-w-0 (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:124). Widest unbreakable item is 192px vs about 256px content width. Not browser-verified: the native date input at min 144px (9rem, px-3) may clip its picker icon.

No form controls render when readOnly: weekly hours as <ul aria-label='Weekly hours'> with day and summary text (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:105-113), timezone as text (TimezoneCard.tsx:48-49), closures as list text (ClosuresList.tsx:102-111), buffers/limit as <dl> (BuffersCapCard.tsx:60-76). Add Closure and header actions are omitted when !canEdit (AvailabilityContent.tsx:229-239,281-290). Read-only note is a plain paragraph (AvailabilityBanners.tsx:23-27); it is not referenced by any control because no controls exist.

type='time' (WeeklyHoursCard.tsx:155,170); type='date' with min/max from AVAILABILITY_LIMITS, and end min follows the start date (ClosuresList.tsx:133-135,148-150). Native pickers give keyboard operation. Empty values are handled by validation. Advisory F9 on missing visible labels.

checks.criterion: AppointmentForm submit error and help text
checks.evidence: Submit error is role=alert (AppointmentForm.tsx diff, id form-submit-error) and is cleared via form onChange and re-created on each submit, so identical repeat errors re-announce. Timezone help linked with describedBy to the select trigger (AppointmentForm.tsx:~304-310, TimezoneSelector.tsx:162). Buffer selects keep the current non-preset value as an option (bufferOptions). text-gray-500 on white is 4.83:1.

checks.criterion: Calendar settings pointers and TimezoneSelector showDetect
checks.evidence: AvailabilityPointer is a real link with underline and descriptive text (AvailabilityPointer.tsx:9-11) but fails contrast (F1). TimezoneSelector with showDetect=false removes the Detect button without leaving an orphaned control (TimezoneSelector.tsx:180-190). Removed buffer/timezone inputs in BufferRemindersTab/CalendarIntegrationTab leave no dangling label or describedby references; the new defaultReminderMinutes-help id resolves.

findings.problem: Link uses text-primary (#2877f6, globals.css:158) at 14px on slate-50 (#f8fafc): 3.97:1 in light mode. In dark mode the box is slate-800/50 over the dark card: 3.52:1. Both are under 4.5:1 for normal text. The underline helps with 1.4.1 only, not contrast. Newly added by this PR, in two places (BufferRemindersTab and CalendarIntegrationTab).
findings.fix: Use a darker token for the link in light mode (for example text-blue-700, #1d4ed8, about 6.7:1 on slate-50) and a lighter one in dark mode (dark:text-blue-300, about 8:1+). Do not change the global --primary in this PR.

findings.problem: handleReload refetches, adopts the data and clears serverError, which unmounts the ServerErrorBanner (AvailabilityBanners.tsx:83) while it holds focus (it was focused on mount, line 79-81). Focus falls to document.body. The Reload button the user just pressed is also removed. The spec says focus goes to the Weekly hours title after Reload (PG-202-spec.md:370) and the test does not assert focus (AvailabilityContent.actions.test.tsx:178-193).
findings.fix: In handleReload, after adopt(result.data), call setFocusTarget(WEEKLY_HOURS_TITLE_ID). Also set focus when result.data is missing (keep the banner mounted, or focus the Retry/Save). Add an assertion that document.activeElement is the Weekly hours heading.

findings.problem: The modal <dialog open aria-modal> has no accessible name (no aria-label or aria-labelledby, and its h3 headings at 588,625,662,742,775 have no ids). Previously the whole wrapper was aria-hidden so this was masked; removing aria-hidden (correctly) now exposes a role=dialog with no name (axe aria-dialog-name, serious). Not caught by tests because the detail dialog is not under axe.
findings.fix: Give each dialog heading an id (or one shared id since only one renders) and set aria-labelledby on the <dialog>. Add an axe or getByRole('dialog', { name }) assertion to AppointmentDetail.test.tsx.

findings.problem: On a failed Reset, confirmReset catches the error and sets serverError (212) instead of throwing, so ConfirmationDialog still runs onOpenChange(false) (confirmation-dialog.tsx:80). The banner takes focus on mount, then Radix restores focus to the Reset trigger on close, so the banner focus is likely lost. The role=alert still announces, so the message is not lost, but sighted keyboard users get focus on Reset rather than the error. Based on code reading only; not reproduced.
findings.fix: Rethrow in confirmReset so the dialog stays open (the dialog logs and keeps open on throw), or set focusTitleOnCloseRef-style flag to focus the banner in onCloseAutoFocus on failure.

findings.problem: Unchecked Switch track is bg-input (#e2e8f0) with a bg-background thumb: track vs white card is 1.24:1 and the thumb is near-identical to the track, so off-state and boundary are nearly invisible. Same token gives text input borders (input.tsx:11, border-input) 1.23:1 on white, 1.43:1 in dark. Pre-existing shared tokens, not introduced by PG-202, but this page is dominated by seven switches and many inputs.
findings.fix: Out of scope to change here: file a follow-up to use a border/track token of at least 3:1 (for example slate-400 #94a3b8 is 2.56:1, slate-500 #64748b is 4.76:1). Consider noting it in the VPAT row as a known gap.

findings.problem: Primary action (Save Changes) is white bold 14px on #2877f6: 4.15:1; default Button (Add Closure) is the same pair. Under 4.5:1 and 14px bold is not 'large text'. Pre-existing shared token and component; disabled state is exempt.
findings.fix: Follow-up: darken --primary or the button background token (for example hsl 217 92% 50% gives about 4.9:1 with white). Not a PG-202 change.

findings.problem: ErrorSummary is role=alert and is recomputed on every keystroke once submitted (AvailabilityContent.tsx:135-138), so its count text ('3 problems need fixing' -> '2 problems...') is re-announced assertively while the user is typing in a field. When the last error clears the alert unmounts silently. The first error is also read twice on submit (alert plus focused field's describedby).
findings.fix: Keep role=alert for the first display but freeze the summary until the next Save, or make the count text aria-live=off after first render (the links and per-field errors already update). Optional.

findings.problem: The document-level Escape handler closes the dialog even while isActionLoading is true, and it also fires if an open Radix popover inside the dialog is dismissed with Escape. The in-flight action's result then lands on a closed dialog.
findings.fix: Ignore Escape when isActionLoading, and check event.defaultPrevented before closing.

findings.problem: Start/end time inputs and start/end date inputs (ClosuresList.tsx:131-157) are named only by aria-label; sighted users see just 'to' between them and a placeholder on the reason input. The accessible names are correct, so this passes 1.3.1/4.1.2; it is a usability note.
findings.fix: Optional: add visually visible 'From'/'Until' text or a column header.

findings.problem: EmptyState entity mode renders role=region with tabIndex=0, nested inside the Closures <section aria-labelledby>, producing a second landmark (named 'No closures' via the aria-label override in props, spread at line 411) and an extra tab stop on non-interactive content. Pre-existing component behaviour.

The announcement state is never cleared, so an identical message set twice in a row (for example Reset twice) does not re-render and is not re-announced; stale text stays in the sr-only output. The 'Unsaved changes' text appearing (AvailabilityBanners.tsx:33-35) is visual only.
findings.fix: Optional: clear the message after a timeout or append a zero-width toggle.

findings.problem: The log is 474 bytes: it records '10 test files, 104 tests passed' only. The axe assertions exist at AvailabilityContent.test.tsx:68-70 and 197-227 (color-contrast disabled), but the log itself carries no axe output and the detail dialog and AvailabilityPointer are not covered by axe at all.
findings.fix: Do not cite the log as axe evidence beyond 'tests passed'; the contrast numbers below are the only contrast evidence.

limitations: Review is by code reading and arithmetic only; no browser, no screen reader, no axe run. Contrast ratios are computed from the HSL tokens in globals.css (lines 152-199) and the default Tailwind v4 palette, using the WCAG relative-luminance formula; semi-transparent fills (red-950/40, slate-800/50) were composited over the card colour. Not verified without a running browser: real focus order and where Radix restores focus after a failed Reset (F4); whether the focused disabled Save/Confirm buttons keep focus in each browser; native time/date widget width and picker-icon clipping at 320px; how NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver announce role=alert inserted while focus moves in the same tick (summary plus focused field); whether the toast component exposes a live region for 'Availability saved' (not read); aria-modal support when the page behind a non-modal <dialog open> is not inert. The axe evidence in the TDD log is a pass count only and had color-contrast disabled.
